item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed action by the Department of Justice on 14 outstanding recommendations from its earlier prison misconduct reports.
item.support: This report outlines the actions taken by DoJ to address the remaining 14 recommendations.

item.text: The recommendations covered matters including staff supervision, use of force reporting and training, screening, information sharing and monitoring of misconduct prevention.
item.support: Introduce a system to track and measure the effectiveness of serious misconduct strategies

item.text: The Commission concluded that the department had made substantial progress and closed all 51 recommendations from the six earlier reports.
item.support: The Commission considers all 51 recommendations now closed.

item.quote: The Commission considers DoJ has taken appropriate steps to address the remaining 14 recommendations.
The Commission considers all 51 recommendations now closed.
